meta.name: Burke's Law
meta.description:
The only PD episode of Burke's Law.

Episode Title: "Who Killed Jason Shaw" S1 E15

This show was originally set to air on 22 November 1963. It was pushed back by the network's coverage of John F Kennedy's assassination.

This film is in the public domain because its copyright was not renewed in 1991, which was the necessary time for any film with a date in notice of 1963.
